dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Hello there. Looking for something? Don't be shy, feel free to look around...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you afraid I might break something?

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Of course not. If you break something, you'll have to pay for it, that's all. But if the matter troubles you so...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: I can be one to bring out and show you the objects that take your fancy. And if they break then...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Heh, I suppose it'll come out of my salary.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I ask for more detailed information?

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Absolutely. Simply speak with our boss, Blyushko.

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: I only work here, so I couldn't tell you much about where these things come from...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: But I'm sure there are some things here of... unknown provenance. When I came to interview for this job, the boss had me repeatedly affirm that I had no relatives serving in the Druzhna before letting me in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not much I want to look at for now...
